profile_positions.description:
I am super excited to start my new role for Harmonic Security, covering the TOLA region.

AI is here to stay and the productivity it enables is undeniable.  But knowing and governing how it is being used within an organization is a huge security black hole.  Sensitive corporate and personal data are being sent out by employees, used as LLM training data or worse exfiltrated, while being sent with no thought on where it is going or how it is being used. 

Harmonic Security delivers the Easy Button to Secure AI adoption.  With visibility into more than 600 AI tools, you can enforce your corporate policies by knowing and controlling who is using which AI tools, what type of data is being sent and how it is being used. 

Harmonic Security offers the most advanced capabilities to safely enable AI within the workforce via our browser extension, MCP gateway and extensive use of small language models to provide the most comprehensive visibility, enablement and enforcement of your AI tools and policies.

awards.description:
Jessica’s impact is global—her ability to streamline business processes, improve channel engagement, and strengthen relationships with partners has set a new standard for the industry. In 2024, she is focused on automating billing, enhancing reporting, and increasing margins for LastPass partners worldwide. Her dedication to expanding enablement through a new partner portal and automating processes reflects her commitment to making it easier for partners to do business with LastPass.

Jessica has a proven track record of creating and enhancing channel programs that drive revenue and sales, consistently improving partner engagement and processes. Her leadership is defined by her ability to streamline business operations and provide partners with the resources they need to succeed, including enhanced automation for billing and reporting. In 2024, her team expects to surpass 2023’s growth by 15%, driven by continuous improvements in automation and enablement.

As LastPass transitions into a stand-alone company, Jessica is leading efforts to expand the channel program, focusing on building community and increasing the value MSPs derive from selling LastPass products. Her commitment to education and innovation has positioned her as a trusted partner for channel success, and she is dedicated to helping MSPs protect their customers’ environments with cost-effective and scalable solutions.

Jessica’s passion for the channel is evident through her dedication to building a strong partner program for MSPs. Her approach not only provides partners with the ability to generate long-term margins but also empowers them with tools to scale adoption and proactively manage security for their customers.
